# Navoraa

Navoraa is a Perth, Western Australia-based cloud, enterprise AI, security and platform engineering consultancy serving Australian enterprises and government organisations.

## Core services

- Cloud and AI strategy and enterprise architecture
- Microsoft Cloud Adoption Framework (CAF) and Azure Well-Architected Framework (WAF) assessments
- Secure Azure landing zones and cloud foundations
- Enterprise AI platform foundations and AI enablement
- Microsoft 365 platform assessment and Microsoft Copilot adoption
- Platform engineering, DevSecOps and cloud operations
- FinOps, resilience, security posture and cloud optimisation

## Approach

Navoraa connects business intent, architecture, governance and hands-on delivery. Engagements are designed to create clear decisions, secure reusable platforms, accountable operating models and measurable outcomes.

## Service area

Perth and Western Australia, with services available to organisations across Australia.
